resources.string: The Power User Telegram Client. Fast, secure, and engineered for high throughput.
TeleForge delivers messages faster than any other application using Telegram\'s native MTProto network.
Your chats, your way. Organize high-traffic spaces with deep custom filter controls.
TeleForge provides power-user tooling without compromising Telegram\'s rock-solid core.
TeleForge keeps your conversations safe with Telegram\'s proven cryptographic substrate.
TeleForge lets you access your messages from multiple devices seamlessly.
